name: Rei
source:
A girl who joined the Magic Academy at the same time as the protagonist.
Rei comes from the demon world with the purpose of assassinating the protagonist, who is believed to be the prince of the Holy Royal Family.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=4120]Getchu[/url].]
